questions.prompt: Which of these trees keep their leaves all year?
questions.fact: Evergreens do drop their leaves, just a few at a time instead of all at once in autumn.

questions.prompt: Which of these are noble gases?
questions.fact: Noble gases have full outer electron shells, which is why they barely react. Helium was found in the Sun's light before it was found on Earth.

questions.prompt: How fast can a cheetah run, in km/h?
questions.fact: Around 110 km/h in a short burst, and 0 to 100 in about three seconds, quicker than most sports cars.

questions.prompt: In which country did the Industrial Revolution begin?
questions.hint: It started with cotton mills and coal mines in the 1700s.
questions.fact: Britain had coal, iron, rivers and a big empire to sell to, all at once.

questions.prompt: Which language has the most native speakers?
questions.hint: Not the most learned, the most born into.
questions.fact: Mandarin has around 940 million native speakers. English has more speakers in total once second languages are counted.
